# Atlas Charts

> Create visual representations of your data with Atlas Charts, featuring built-in aggregation, seamless integration with MongoDB Atlas, and various chart types.

- [Add a Lookup Field](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/add-lookup-field.md): Create a chart with a lookup field to join data from multiple collections, using $lookup to retrieve matching documents from a remote collection.
- [Data Transfer](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/admin-settings.md): Access and monitor your Atlas Charts data usage, including total data transfer and free tier remaining, on the Data Transfer page.
- [Backing Aggregation Pipeline](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/aggregation-pipeline-generation.md): Understand how MongoDB Charts generates an aggregation pipeline to render data, using various settings like queries, calculated fields, and filters.
- [Run Aggregation Pipelines on Your Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/aggregation-pipeline.md): Transform documents into aggregated results using aggregation pipelines in Atlas Charts, with examples and error handling guidance.
- [AI and Data Usage Information](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/ai-and-data-usage-information.md): Understand how Natural Language Charts use Generative AI and manage data usage, including disabling the feature if desired.
- [Apply a Suggested Chart](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/apply-suggested-charts.md): Apply a suggested prebuilt chart in Atlas Charts and customize it by changing the chart type or modifying fields.
- [Bin, Sort, and Limit Your Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/bin-data.md): Learn to bin, sort, and limit data in MongoDB Charts using date, numeric, and string binning to group and highlight key trends in your visualizations.
- [Chart Building Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/build-charts-reference.md): Explore how Atlas Charts samples data and creates aggregation pipelines for efficient data rendering.
- [Build Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/build-charts.md): Create visual representations of data using charts in dashboards, selecting data sources and customizing chart types and fields.
- [Calculate New Data Fields](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/calculated-fields.md): Create calculated fields in MongoDB Charts by combining data from existing fields using expressions or operators for enhanced data analysis.
- [Candlestick Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/candlestick-chart.md): Use MongoDB Charts candlestick charts to visualize time series data and track opening, closing, high, and low numeric values for each consecutive time period.
- [Choropleth Chart Shape Schemes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/choropleth-regions.md): Explore shape schemes for defining regions in choropleth charts, including accepted values and examples for each scheme.
- [Choropleth Chart](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/choropleth.md): Explore how to use choropleth charts to visualize regional differences using shading based on aggregated values without needing coordinate data.
- [Circular Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/circular-charts.md): Explore how donut and gauge charts visually represent data proportions and percentages using circular segments and semicircles.
- [Column and Bar Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/column-bar-chart.md): Explore how to use column and bar charts to visualize data trends, including encoding channels, chart types, use cases, and customization options.
- [Combo Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/combo-charts.md): Explore how to create and customize combo charts in MongoDB Charts, combining column and line views with encoding channels, chart sub-types, and visual options.
- [Table](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/data-table.md): Explore how to use tables in MongoDB Charts to display data in tabular format, with encoding channels, customization options, and conditional formatting.
- [Limit the Rows a Table Displays](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/data-table/limit-rows.md): Limit the number of rows displayed in a data table to control data visibility for viewers, with options to sort within the defined row limit.
- [Reorder Table Columns](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/data-table/reorder-columns.md): Reorder table columns in the Chart Builder by dragging headers or modifying column encoding channels, with changes saved for all users.
- [Resize Table Text](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/data-table/resize-table-text.md): Resize table chart text by adjusting the pixel size of header, body, and footer text in the Chart Builder's Customize tab.
- [Sort and Resize Table Columns](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/data-table/sort-resize-columns.md): Sort and resize table columns in dashboards or the Chart Builder, with changes persisting only when made in the Chart Builder.
- [Toggle Table Row and Column Totals](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/data-table/toggle-row-column-totals.md): Enable or disable row and column totals in data tables through the Chart Builder's Customization tab.
- [Donut Chart](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/donut-chart.md): Visualize data proportions with donut charts, using encoding channels for categories and aggregation, and customize labels for values or percentages.
- [Empty Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/empty-charts.md): Explore what causes an empty state to display, with an accompanying visual representation.
- [Gauge Chart](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/gauge-chart.md): Explore gauge charts in MongoDB Charts to display a data value as a percentage of a semicircle. Configure encoding channels and target and maximum values.
- [Geospatial Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/geo-spatial.md): Explore various geospatial chart types like choropleth, scatter, and heatmap to visualize geographical data using MongoDB.
- [Geospatial Heatmap](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/geospatial-heatmap.md): Visualize geographic data comparisons using geospatial heatmap charts, adjusting intensity and color based on aggregated values.
- [Geospatial Scatter Chart](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/geospatial-scatter.md): Create geospatial scatter charts in MongoDB Charts to plot location-based data using coordinates, color, and size encoding channels with customization options.
- [Grid Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/grid-charts.md): Explore how Atlas Charts uses grid charts to represent data in a tabular format with heatmaps and scatter charts.
- [Heatmap](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/heatmap.md): Visualize data patterns and trends using heatmaps, which represent aggregated values with varying color intensities across a tabular format.
- [Line and Area Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/line-area-chart.md): Explore how to use line and area charts to visualize data trends over time, with options for discrete and continuous data, customization, and encoding channels.
- [Natural Language Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/natural-language-charts.md): Create natural language charts by entering prompts to generate various chart types, including bar, column, line, area, number, table, and donut charts.
- [Number Chart](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/number-chart.md): Display a single aggregated value using a number chart to highlight totals or overall data states, with options for conditional formatting.
- [Scatter Chart](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/scatter-chart.md): Explore how to use scatter charts to plot data points with optional encoding channels for size, color, and shape to represent additional data dimensions.
- [Text Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/text-charts.md): Explore different text chart types, including tables, number charts, word clouds, and Top Item charts, to represent and analyze data visually.
- [Top Item Chart](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/top-item.md): Create a Top Item chart to display information from the document with the highest or lowest value for a specified field, using sorting and display options.
- [Word Cloud](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/word-cloud.md): Visualize text data with word clouds, using encoding channels for text, size, and optional color to represent word frequency and data values.
- [Chart Types](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-types.md): Explore various chart types including natural language, column, bar, line, area, combo, grid, circular, text, and geospatial charts.
- [Embed Charts with the Embedding SDK](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/charts-embedding-sdk.md): Embed charts into web applications using the Embedding SDK to customize settings, apply filters, and manage chart rendering and appearance.
- [Configure Embedding Authentication Providers](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/configure-auth-providers.md): Configure authentication providers for embedding charts using tokens from Google or custom JWTs to ensure secure access.
- [Convert Field Data Types](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/convert-field-data-types.md): Convert field data types in MongoDB Charts to different types like numbers, dates, or booleans using the Chart Builder's conversion feature.
- [Create and Manage Charts Views](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/create-manage-charts-view.md): Create and manage charts views by applying aggregation pipelines to collections for data pre-processing before visualization.
- [Customize Charts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/customize-charts.md): Explore options to customize the format and display of Atlas Charts visualizations, including general, axis, field-level, and conditional formatting options.
- [Conditions Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/customize-charts/conditional-formatting-reference.md): Explore configuration options for applying conditional formatting to charts based on chart type and value type, including numeric, string, and date operators.
- [Conditional Formatting](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/customize-charts/conditional-formatting.md): Customize chart values in Atlas Charts using conditional formatting to modify styling based on defined conditions.
- [Customize Field-Level Values](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/customize-charts/field-level-options.md): Customize how Atlas Charts displays data fields, including field labels, number formats, and date formats, with options for time zone conversion.
- [Customize Color Palette, Labels, Chart Types, and Legend](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/customize-charts/general-customization.md): Explore general customization options for Atlas Charts, including color palette adjustments, label resizing, and legend positioning for various chart types.
- [Customize Chart's Axes Values](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/customize-charts/value-axis-options.md): Customize a chart's value axes in MongoDB Atlas Charts, with options for max/min values, logarithmic scales, custom label overrides, and secondary Y axes.
- [Embed Dashboards with the Embedding SDK](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards-embedding-sdk.md): Embed a dashboard into a web application using the Embedding SDK to customize settings and rendering.
- [Dashboards](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards.md): Explore how to create, view, and manage dashboards in MongoDB Charts, including adding sample and billing dashboards for data visualization.
- [Dashboard Access](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/dashboard-access.md): Manage dashboard access by viewing, adding, or removing owners and controlling user permissions in your project.
- [Dashboard Ownership](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/dashboard-access/dashboard-ownership.md): Manage dashboard ownership by viewing, adding, or removing owners in your project.
- [Dashboard Permissions and Sharing](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/dashboard-access/dashboard-permissions.md): Manage dashboard permissions in Atlas Charts to control user access and actions, including viewing, modifying, and sharing dashboards.
- [Import and Export a Dashboard](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/dashboard-import-export.md): Export or import dashboards in Atlas Charts to manage and transfer chart configurations and data sources between projects.
- [Manage Dashboards](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards.md): Create and manage dashboards to visualize Atlas billing data using prebuilt charts in Atlas Charts.
- [Create and Manage Billing Dashboards](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/billing-dashboards.md): Visualize and manage your Atlas billing data by creating customizable billing dashboards with prebuilt charts to monitor usage and optimize spending.
- [Manage Existing Dashboards](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/manage-dashboards/existing-dashboards.md): Manage existing dashboards by duplicating, editing, resizing, or deleting them, depending on your user permissions.
- [View Dashboard Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/view-dashboard-data.md): Explore how to view, refresh, and export data from dashboards in Atlas Charts, including options for fullscreen viewing and data download.
- [Filter Dashboards by Field Values](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/view-dashboard-data/dashboard-filtering.md): Filter dashboard data by field values to view a common subset across charts, with options to add, edit, and manage filters for personalized data views.
- [Refresh Dashboard Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/view-dashboard-data/dashboard-refresh.md): Configure and manually refresh dashboard data in Atlas Charts, setting staleness tolerance and handling refresh failures.
- [Interact with Charts on a Dashboard](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/view-dashboard-data/interact-with-charts.md): Interact with charts on a dashboard by using features like interactive filtering, emphasizing series, zooming, and viewing data percentages or original data.
- [Schedule Dashboard Reports](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/dashboards/view-dashboard-data/scheduled-reports.md): Create, edit, and delete scheduled dashboard reports to automatically send snapshots of data to users at regular intervals.
- [Data Sources](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/data-sources.md): Explore how to manage and connect data sources in Atlas Charts, including editing chart data sources and using sample data.
